$sources: MNBC 2020 Part 3 (structural design): the seismic zone map of Myanmar with the mapped spectral accelerations SS and S1 of the towns, and the basic wind speed by region (VERIFY.md N1-N3)
source: MNBC 2020: zone = the MNBC seismic zone (1 to 5, for information); ss, s1 [g]: the mapped MCE spectral accelerations at 0.2 s and 1 s on site class B, from which the design spectrum is made with the site coefficients Fa and Fv (seismic.designSpectrum.siteCoefficients); windSpeed: the basic wind speed V [m/s], 3-second gust at 10 m in exposure C, 50-year (with the 1.6W combinations). The SS and S1 here are SAEngine estimates from the zone (VERIFY.md N2) and the speeds SAEngine readings by region (N3): replace them with the values of the MNBC tables for the town before design. A project's own SS and S1 (Site > Mapped spectral values) take precedence. Elsewhere a custom location (enter SS, S1 and V).
